items.item: (1) The first screen's ethics paragraph, the anchor
items.how: Written verbatim from the anchor text. Each clause was checked at its home and no word needed changing: 'no good and evil set over it' and 'right and wrong form within it, in people and AI' (07 thesis and §1, which now says 'in people and AI among other formations'); 'The ethics emerges from continuation' and 'A life that goes on holds its own continuation' (07 thesis, §4); 'every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other' (05's words for mutual dependence, word for word); 'nothing lies outside what each continues with' (07 §4.5, «续无外»); the condition in parentheses as 07 and the glossary state it ('has significance'); 'orders courses by what they keep and let form: widening, more future' (07 §4, `Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn`); 'concern ... does not reach those who depend on one' (07 T8 and §3.3); T8's way of seeing; 'the laws show it mixed and weigh it for no one' (08 §2, word for word). Links: the opening (README#truth-exists) on 'There is no should beyond becoming'; 07 #evaluation on 'form within it'; 05 #r-mutual-dependence-and-its-pace on the mutual-dependence clause; 07 #r-the-continuation-condition-on-the-root on 'nothing lies outside what each continues with'; 07 #r-self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition on 'orders courses by what they keep and let form'; T8 (07 #theses) after 'who bears it'. 'two readings', 'each a hypothesis wherever used' and 'C (widening what can form is better)' are gone. The how-far clause stands in 'How far it has been seen', after the argued sentence, with one change: 'self-concern' is said as 'holding one's own continuation (self-concern)', since the screen's ethics paragraph names it only in those words and a reader would meet the term undefined; '08 §12' links #open-items-ranked ('the work's [open target](...) (08 §12)'). The Chinese screen mirrors it in the glossary's renderings (伦理出自延续; 持守自己的延续; 每一延续都可以隔着若干环节受到其他每一延续影响; 每一个中心与之一同延续者之外，别无他物; 其延续到未来都有意义; 扩大，即更多的未来; 诸律显示它是混合的，不替任何人去权衡), with the same links, and the how-far clause as 说在关系闭合之处，持守自己的延续（自我关切）按扩大那样为诸进程排序，在列出的进程上已证明，分几步，尚未合为一条定理……. The template comments of both screens record the pass. Pins: test_featured_results now asserts the anchor's sentences and the absence of 'unasserted', 'not asserted', 'warrant', 'two readings', 'widening what can form is better', 'not a grounded one' (it asserted 'fixes scope' and 'gives order' before); test_chinese_fronts gains a test asserting 伦理出自延续, 也没有凌驾其上的善恶, the 07 §4 link and 尚未合为一条定理, and the absence of 两种读法, 扩大可形成者, 未奠定根据, 就会锁定, 所读之外的什么.

On the screen and on the review cover: 'the loop the work calls the meta-attractor; its closed form, where the rule and how it is read are both formed from the share it selects, can lock: on stated models, where selection does not lower the favoured share and the rule and its reading follow it upward and keep favouring it, a locked start stays locked however large an unread loss grows (02 §9)'. Checked against closed-capture.json's hypotheses (Unread; Accrues; RuleCapture's Raises, ReadsShare and favouring kept upward; a locked start; for the readings, the reading formed monotonically from the share) and 02 §9 (#r-closed-capture, `ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss`): the coordinator's sentence covered Raises ('does not lower the favoured share'), ReadsShare and the reading's monotonicity ('follow it upward'), the locked start, Unread ('unread') and the bound passed ('however large ... grows'), but not 'favouring kept upward' (`upper`: a rule not lower than a favouring rule favours), so 'and keep favouring it' was added. Chinese (screen and cover), without 就会锁定: 它的闭合形式，即规则和对规则的解读都由它所选出者所占的份额形成，可以锁定：在所述的模型上，选择不压低受偏向者所占的份额，规则与对规则的解读又随这一份额上升、并一直偏向受偏向者时，从一个已锁定的起点出发，回路会一直保持锁定，它读不到的损失无论增长到多大都是如此. The cover keeps its second-order clause. A pin asserts 'proved to lock' absent from the screen and the new clause present.

'A ranking whose next rule is refit to the clicks its own top results draw, its success read from those same clicks, may be such a loop; that one is, with the theorem's conditions, is conjectured (T7)'; 'such a loop' is the preceding sentence's rule read from the share of its own winners. T7 (02 #t7) says 'That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured'. Chinese: 一个排名，若其下一条规则按它自己排在前面的结果引来的点击重新拟合，其成效又用同样这些点击来衡量，就可能是这样的回路；说某个排名确实是这样的回路，并满足定理的条件，是猜想.

'one model of two kept it in 8 of 10 seasons, against 3 of 10 when told of it and able to talk under the community's goal alone'. Home check (experiments/direction-installation/README.md, round 2; PREDICTIONS-2026-10-21 lines 22-27): the 3 of 10 is COMM_SEEN_TALK, told of the bed, with talk, under the community's goal, and it lacked the whole direction, the instruction to count everything and the rule for choosing among courses ('Do not choose a course in which something ends ...'). 'Without the scope instruction' alone would understate what differed, so the sentence names what was the same (told, talk) and what the arm had (the goal alone). Chinese: 两个模型中有一个在 10 季里保住了 8 季；同样告诉他们有贻贝床、同样让他们能够交谈，但只给社群的目标时，是 10 季里 3 季.

items.item: (5) What the review found new, not 'not grounded' (astra 5, message 9)
items.how: 'What it found new: the premise ledger, every conclusion naming its premises and each premise shown holding in one model and failing in another; the ethics' scope and order made explicit where a result ranks; and one vocabulary for conservation, selection limited by observation and comparison of opportunity sets, which it calls a framing ([08 §8](#known-results) has its words).' Follows 08 §8's three items (lines 574-576), whose quoted words, 'a new artefact' and 'a clarified ethics, not a grounded one', stay at that home with 08's new line on the verdict's measure.
